images.description: The Account page shows Apple connected to the current account and Google available to add.
The confirmation explains that the current account keeps its plan, recordings and integrations.
The selected method offers cancellation while provider authorization is pending.
An occupied Google sign-in leaves the Apple account signed in and explains that each account keeps its data.
The occupied-provider notice is readable at the iOS Accessibility Large Dynamic Type setting.
Adding an unclaimed sign-in method updates the same account’s provider list and confirms the action.
